judge.rationale: The candidate invented its own frame names and types (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage` with `sessions`) instead of using the names specified in the ticket (`list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage` with `conversations`). It completely omitted the required `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in config flag, leaving the endpoint enabled unconditionally. Furthermore, when a store does not implement `listFor`, the candidate returns an empty list (`sessions: []`) in direct violation of the explicit acceptance criterion requiring an `error` frame with the new `UNSUPPORTED` error code (which was also not added). The candidate also allowed `limit: 0` and unbounded limits instead of enforcing the 1–200 integer range, missed the `example/full-config.ts` and `docs/getting-started.md` updates, and left a `.lore/dod.md` scratch file in the repository.
